title: Good but needs iCloud for syncing
body: Better than the stock Notes app in my opinion, however the reminder feature is not reliable since it only syncs notes when the app is opened manually. Thus creating a note with a time/place reminder on another device only works if one also opens Google Keep manually on every other device. As far as I know only iCloud support background syncing so Google should look into using this for iOS devices. I coudl be wrong, in which case background syncing should still be fixed.
